message:
I should add that I also like biographies. Not everything I read is **that** mindless. Right now I'm reading [Charmed Circle: Gertrude Stein and Company](http://www.amazon.com/exec/obidos/tg/detail/-/0805073515/103-4459015-8092638?v=glance), which I scored for one dollar, used, at the Friends of the Library bookstore down here. That will most likely be my plane-reading on the way back to MN.
:-)
